subject.title: feat(localization): add locale context and message rendering

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared localization runtime, `OPENCLAW_LOCALE` process selector, Gateway descriptor convention, and global coverage gate as permanent core contracts before the remaining localization series proceeds?
rationale: The patch introduces new cross-surface APIs and an environment/configuration behavior that cannot be validated as a routine implementation detail without deciding the intended long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow foundation
options.body: Approve the shared runtime and its explicit public contract after defining ownership, documentation, and upgrade expectations, then require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep localization surface-owned
options.body: Decline the new global runtime and ask for smaller owner-local changes using existing UI, wizard, and channel seams.

options.title: Pause for RFC decision
options.body: Keep the series open but defer code review until the linked localization RFC records the accepted core and plugin boundaries.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow foundation
recommendation.body: Approve the shared runtime and its explicit public contract after defining ownership, documentation, and upgrade expectations, then require real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete design owner identified in the supplied PR and RFC-series context; a core maintainer must still make the final product decision.
